name: context overview
reason: The operator: the design state a session reads was long human prose restating facts across concepts and carrying decisions with their situations; its reader is a model, so the state is the design alone, each concept as its established name and residue, and decisions and their reasons are history. No prose account of the design is kept: a session reads the design state, per context where its work touches one, and the operator reads the architect's read-back.
